editionLabel: Kinson Key Games English Training Manual
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently went on a cruise or vacation goes first and takes the First Player token.
clarifications: Starting with that player and going clockwise, players draw their opening Agenda cards.
The first player starts with 0 Reputation; later players begin with 1, 2, or 3 Reputation in turn order.
